sections.text_helper: Section 9.8.19 "RCC APB1 peripheral clock register (RCC_APB1HENR)" in chapter 9 (Reset and clock control (RCC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 302.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0A0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:10 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 9 FDCANEN: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 clock enable
Set and reset by software.
0: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 clock disabled (default after reset)
1: FDCAN1 and FDCAN2 clock enabled
Bits 8:4 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 3 COMPEN: COMP clock enable
Set and reset by software.
0: COMP clock disabled (default after reset)
1: COMP clock enabled
Bits 2:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
